tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary may acquire land and interests in land within the boundary of the Park described in section 430f–8(b) of this title, by—

children.text: purchase with donated or appropriated funds; or

tree.heading: Exception
tree.text: Land may be acquired only by donation from—

children.text: the State of Mississippi (including a political subdivision of the State);
the State of Tennessee (including a political subdivision of the State); or
the organization known as “Friends of the Siege and Battle of Corinth”.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2007—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 110–161 substituted “described in section 430f–8(b) of this title” for “as depicted on the Map” in introductory provisions.
